Definition: User account is created and receives stable user_id
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, registration_source, platform
Validation: user_id exists; event_id unique; timestamp valid

Definition: A user session is established after successful authentication
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, session_id, auth_method
Validation: session_id unique per session; do not log credentials

Definition: User explicitly ends a session
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, session_id
Validation: Match existing session_id; tolerate missing explicit logout

Definition: User begins onboarding flow
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, onboarding_version
Validation: One event per onboarding attempt/version

Trigger: All required onboarding steps are completed
Definition: Onboarding completion is confirmed by system
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, onboarding_version
Validation: Backend completion state must be authoritative

Definition: System records a transition between account states
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, old_status, new_status
Validation: Allowed state transition; retain audit trail

Definition: User views a task detail page/card
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, task_id, feature
Validation: Deduplicate repeated view bursts using event_id; do not collapse valid repeat views

Definition: Task detail screen is opened
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, task_id
Validation: Require task_id and valid user/session

Definition: User initiates a task attempt
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, session_id, task_id, task_activity_id
Validation: Idempotency key per task_activity_id/start action

Definition: A task attempt is confirmed complete
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, task_id, task_activity_id, status, validation_status
Validation: Only emit after validation; one logical completion per activity ID

Trigger: Task attempt fails or is abandoned with a known outcome
Definition: A task attempt reaches a failed/abandoned terminal state
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, task_id, task_activity_id, failure_category
Validation: Use controlled taxonomy; never invent provider codes

Trigger: Eligible activity creates a pending reward
Definition: Reward is recorded but not yet final/available
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, reward_transaction_id, source_activity_id, amount, unit, status
Validation: Unique reward_transaction_id; amount >= 0

Trigger: Reward is posted to user balance/ledger
Definition: Reward becomes an available credited entry
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, reward_transaction_id, source_activity_id, amount, unit, status
Validation: Idempotent ledger posting; one credit per reward transaction

Definition: A posted reward is reversed with a linked reference
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, reward_transaction_id, original_transaction_id, amount, unit, reason_category
Validation: Original transaction must exist; reversal cannot silently overwrite original

Definition: User successfully claims the daily reward
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, claim_id, reward_transaction_id, claim_date
Validation: One valid claim per user/day according to approved rule

Definition: A user's streak count changes
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, streak_id, previous_count, new_count
Validation: new_count >= 0; transition reason retained

Definition: Mission attempt begins
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, mission_id, mission_attempt_id
Validation: Attempt ID unique; mission active/eligible

Definition: Mission completion is confirmed
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, mission_id, mission_attempt_id, completion_status
Validation: Completion must reference valid attempt

Definition: A badge is granted to a user
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, badge_id, award_id
Validation: Award ID unique; badge definition exists

Definition: User starts a spin action
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, spin_id, spin_attempt_id
Validation: Unique spin_attempt_id; eligibility checked server-side

Definition: Spin result is final and any reward is linked
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, spin_id, spin_attempt_id, outcome_type
Validation: One final outcome per attempt; outcome controlled vocabulary

Definition: A referrer creates or shares a referral invitation
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, referral_id, referral_code
Validation: Referral ID unique; referrer user exists

Trigger: Referred user registers with referral attribution
Definition: New user registration is linked to a referral
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, referral_id, referrer_user_id, referred_user_id
Validation: Referrer and referred user differ; one attribution rule

Trigger: Referred user meets approved activation criteria
Definition: Activation condition is met by referred user
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, referral_id, referred_user_id, activation_rule_version
Validation: Activation rule versioned; prevent self-referral if applicable policy confirms

Trigger: Referral satisfies the programme's conversion definition
Definition: Referral reaches approved conversion state
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, referral_id, referred_user_id, conversion_rule_version
Validation: Conversion rule approved and versioned; registration alone is insufficient

Definition: A transaction entry is recorded in wallet ledger
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, transaction_id, transaction_type, amount, unit, status
Validation: Unique transaction_id; amount precision by unit

Definition: Ledger transaction is finalised
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, transaction_id, transaction_type, amount, unit, status
Validation: Valid state transition; immutable transaction history

Definition: A compensating transaction is posted
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, transaction_id, original_transaction_id, amount, unit, status
Validation: Original transaction exists; reversal is separate record

Trigger: Withdrawal request passes initial submission validation
Definition: User submits a withdrawal request
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, withdrawal_id, requested_amount, unit, method
Validation: Unique withdrawal_id; positive amount; do not log payout credentials

Definition: Withdrawal status changes to processing
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, withdrawal_id, status
Validation: Only valid state transition; timestamp order checked

Definition: Withdrawal reaches completed final state
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, withdrawal_id, status, completed_amount, unit
Validation: Backend/provider confirmation required; idempotent finalisation

Definition: Request reaches rejected final state
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, withdrawal_id, status, reason_category
Validation: Reason category approved; avoid free-text sensitive data

Definition: Previously completed payout is reversed
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, withdrawal_id, original_transaction_id, status, amount, unit
Validation: Must link to completed withdrawal and ledger compensation

Trigger: Help article content is rendered to user
Definition: User views a help/help-centre article
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, content_id, content_type
Validation: Do not capture raw sensitive search text by default

Definition: A support ticket record is created
User ID: Required; authenticated user context where applicable
Required Properties: user_id, event_id, event_timestamp, ticket_id, category, channel
Validation: Ticket ID unique; minimise free-text payload
